qualification: ObjectInventoryJob::for_held_source captures the exact HeldChild and its existing OpenedEntry without IO, basename reopening, independent matching-ID substitution, new family or implicit access upgrade. Job/result retain one selected source and parent, not the entire indexed batch/cache. Legacy unique-entry constructor remains valid.

HeldChild::observe_with_access and IndexedSourceLimits::access preserve MetadataOnly defaults and validate access flags before native opening. Explicit requested native rights remain stored in the held observation and unchanged through qualified refresh. Denial cannot trigger downgraded/reopened fallback. Existing handle rights can satisfy a query; missing opt-in/native permissions stay explicit. No mutation/hydration consent or elevation is inferred.

Completed inventory exposes the exact held anchor. held_identity_continuity compares anchor/before/after native IDs, never upgrading unavailable identities to Same; known Different wins over another unavailable comparison. Raw-entry results report Unsupported/Adapter::NotApplicable for anchor comparison. This evidence neither freezes kind/content/membership nor qualifies independent feature owners; compare_owner remains mandatory for payloads.

Existing bounded native inventory phases collect basic metadata, storage, integrity, inode flags, data layout, links/link limits, channel catalog, attributes/binary values and security parts. Completion means attempted query coverage, not complete preservation/operation capability. Query failures remain typed observations. Retained limits do not re-charge already-owned source names/metadata or establish global process/queue bounds.

Native open/basic failures preserve domain/code during simultaneous cancellation, including old-handle refresh inspection. Cancellable layout retries only explicit Adapter::InterruptedRead; other native failures commit before the cancellation yield and do not silently retry on resume. Pause/resume uses the same held object; failure/exception/abandonment releases job-owned references without reopening.

Eight new object-inventory/held-access cases plus one indexed-access case: exact anchor and no reopen after replacement; no implicit upgrade; anchor/initial/final ID change/denial/uncertainty; independently mismatched payload owner; pause/resume/resource failure/bad_alloc/abandon/null factory; real layout failure versus explicit interruption; refresh mask preservation/refusal and invalid access/native failure priority; indexed access forwarding and invalid-mask rejection without IO.

Native259-entry indexed pipeline retains existing159-selection acquisition proof, then explicitly acquires one regular source with attribute/security/layout/inode-query access. It seeds a3-byte binary xattr on Mac/Linux or3-byte ADS on Windows, constructs the held inventory, renames the original and creates a different-ID11-byte replacement. Inventory before/after remain the original7-byte file; POSIX xattr bytes or Windows stream catalog/size and owner check match the original. Inventory remains queryable after indexed source/cache retirement.

Native required rights are never silently upgraded/downgraded by the inventory bridge.

limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 remain unstarted. Destination preservation/collision capabilities, remaining composition and broader qualification are required.

Inventories are bounded live observations, not proof of preservation completeness, atomic filesystem snapshot, stable contents/kind/name membership, operation authorization or scoped metadata-loss consent. Indexed newly acquired bindings still require source review; callers associate inventory results with current request/binding context.

Native requested rights vary by platform. This does not promise every MetadataOnly query is denied or every explicit flag succeeds. Full Windows audit-security requires its separate flag/privileges; missing coverage remains explicit. No automatic elevation, handle dropping, name reopen or downgrade/retry workaround.

Retained query quotas count their documented query payloads and exclude already-owned source snapshots; they are not total RSS/global queues. Applications must bound concurrent workers and retained source/inventory/page results. Native calls may block and cancellation remains cooperative.

Native positive feature qualification: Mac APFS binary xattr, Linux ext4 binary xattr, Windows ReFS alternate-stream catalog. The bridge does not read named-stream content. Other filesystems/providers and all feature combinations still require their own qualification.

No Files UI/rendered-window or full-app latency/RSS/100000-real-directory claim. Existing100000 native cache records are synthetic; real directory integration remains259 entries. Network/removable/provider/crash/full-disk/different-account and complete operation safety qualification remain outstanding.
